findings.text: blocking: the assertion requires the string 'no exclusive write path is enumerated' in reckon/crew source (crew_source is reckon/crew.py plus reckon/crew/*.py per :1905-1910), which reckon/crew/node.py:1489 removes, so test_ship_documents_dispatch_prerequisites_and_refusal_remedies fails at the reviewed head.

blocking: the test asserts result['refused'] == 1 and that entry n-b2 is refused with 'write-paths' in its reason, which is exactly the behaviour reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:614 removes, so the suite fails at the reviewed head; the focused gate could not see it.

non-blocking: the new _DONE_WHEN_TEST_PATH duplicates _TEST_PATH_PATTERN at reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:687 and diverges by accepting test/ as well as tests/, so the negative-control trigger at node.py:1092 and dispatch_batch.py:422's done-when reading recognise different path sets; dispatch_batch.py:408-411 documents that one owner precisely so no second rule drifts from it.

non-blocking: the comment above the negative-control call still states the trigger is the declared write path rather than the done-when prose, which this change makes false for a node declaring no paths.

non-blocking: the fragment names the after arm's revision as 868f65ccc while gate-after.log's header names 605eb2475a47809ac98bf80a906b7a4d9646b537, so the receipt disagrees with the log it cites on the one fact a later reader checks.

non-blocking: assert all(path.startswith((...)) for path in pointer['node']['write_paths']) is vacuously true when the list is empty, so it cannot fail the regression it names; the same shape sits at :223 and neither asserts the grant is non-empty.

non-blocking: the assertion compares the stored fence against the literal the test itself handed to _entry rather than an independent source, so it is a round-trip check rather than a guard on dispatch_batch.py:614's handling of a declared node.

item_verdicts.diff: read all three commits (ffaac726a6, 868f65cccd, 605eb2475a) against 6cb753ef86; five files changed, 375 insertions and 18 deletions, all inside the declared roots.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_node_needs_no_write_paths.py, and the manifest records both arms: gate-after.log carries revision 605eb2475a and EXIT=0 for 6 passed, gate-base.log carries 6cb753ef86 and EXIT=4 because the new file does not exist at the base.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that a node is dispatched and queued with no write paths; reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:614 stops refusing a section that states no write-paths sentence, reckon/crew/node.py:1489 stops failing the scoped property on an empty fence, and reckon/crew/node.py:1078 reads the negative-control trigger from the done-when when no paths are declared.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records 6 passed at 605eb2475a, a base arm that collects no test (EXIT=4), a negative control at 4 failed / 2 passed, and names gate-after.log, gate-base.log and negative-control.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write roots are reckon, tests/test_a_node_needs_no_write_paths.py, docs/evidence/fragments/work-flows-to-the-lane/a-node-needs-no-write-paths.html and the matching docs/figures directory; all five changed paths in the diff lie inside them.

justifications.durability: the recorded negative control reddens four added tests at tests/test_a_node_needs_no_write_paths.py:125,140,156,231, but the direct-dispatch case at :190 never reaches validate_node and the launcher-grant assertion at :181 and :223 is vacuously true on an empty list.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_node_needs_no_write_paths.py is the file the done_when names and its 6-passed EXIT=0 result is in gate-after.log, but the evidence fragment misquotes the after arm's revision at docs/evidence/fragments/work-flows-to-the-lane/a-node-needs-no-write-paths.html:52.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/node.py:1036 follows the module's compiled-pattern idiom, but the comment at :1033-1035 claims its pattern is the repair round's and the comment at :1558 still says the trigger is the declared write path rather than the done-when.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:614 and reckon/crew/node.py:1489 remove the two queue-time refusals and reckon/crew/node.py:1092 reads the check from the done-when, so a path-less node queues, launches and owes the negative control; the landed tree nonetheless breaks two existing suites.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/node.py:1036 adds a second 'a test path a text names' pattern when reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:687 owns it and reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:413 already imports that owner, so the addition duplicates rather than extends it.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path in git diff 6cb753ef86..605eb2475a lies inside the declared write roots, but the removal at reckon/crew/node.py:1489 leaves tests/test_a_batch_queues_the_chosen_sections.py:238 and tests/test_skill_contracts.py:1937 asserting a behaviour the tree no longer has.
